descriptions.bacterial_leaf_blight: A serious bacterial disease causing water-soaked to yellowish stripes on leaf margins. Caused by Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae.
descriptions.brown_spot: A fungal disease causing small circular brown spots with grey centres. Caused by Cochliobolus miyabeanus.
descriptions.healthy: No disease detected. The leaf appears healthy.
descriptions.leaf_blast: A fungal disease producing diamond-shaped lesions with grey centres and brown borders. Caused by Magnaporthe oryzae.
descriptions.leaf_scald: Causes pale yellow-green lesions along leaf margins. Caused by Microdochium oryzae.
descriptions.narrow_brown_spot: Narrow linear brown lesions parallel to leaf veins. Caused by Cercospora janseana.
descriptions.non_rice_leaf: The uploaded image does not appear to be a rice leaf. Please upload a clear photograph of a rice leaf.
